description: For testing, or for orders that arrive by hand. Put order files (PDF, scan, photo, spreadsheet, Word, RTF, saved email or text) in the Knowledge folder Order Desk/Drop and run this. Each file becomes one order, exactly as if it had arrived on the order queue, and the file moves to Order Desk/Drop/Done. Reads up to 15 files a run.
